Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder
  • Enclosing class:
    TcpClientSocketOptions
    public static class TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder
extends Object
    Builds TcpClientSocketOptions instances.

    By default, TCP keep-alive is enabled. SO_LINGER is enabled with a linger time of zero seconds so that closing the socket performs an immediate abortive close, allowing the remote endpoint to promptly detect that the connection has been terminated.

    Other socket options default to null, indicating that the corresponding socket setting should not be changed.

    See Also:

      • withSoLinger

        public TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder withSoLinger​(Boolean on,
                                                   Integer time)
        Sets the socket SO_LINGER configuration.

        When enabled with a linger time of zero, closing the socket performs an immediate abortive close, allowing the remote endpoint to promptly detect that the connection has been terminated. If either argument is null, the SO_LINGER setting is not applied.

        Parameters:
        on - true to enable SO_LINGER, false to disable it, or null to leave the socket setting unchanged
        time - the linger time in seconds, or null to leave the socket setting unchanged
        Returns:
        this builder
